schedules.name: Daily Structure Review
schedules.description: Taxonomy analyzes codebase organization and creates suggestion for human review

tasks.description:
[F] studio/**/*.py, server_modules/**/*.py, backends/**/*.py
[X] ONE suggestion only. Skip code bugs (Audit handles), style preferences, docstrings, type hints.
[>] Review codebase organization: files >500 lines, modules in wrong directories, inconsistent naming, dead files, god classes, circular imports, business logic in wrong layer. Output: create_suggestion titled 'Structure Review - {date}' listing 3-5 issues with file paths and fixes.

schedules.name: Daily Bug Audit
schedules.description: Audit analyzes code for bugs and creates suggestion for human review

tasks.description:
[F] studio/**/*.py, server_modules/**/*.py, backends/**/*.py
[X] ONE suggestion only. Only report provable bugs. Skip structure issues (Taxonomy handles), style preferences, theoretical issues.
[>] Find real bugs: unhandled exceptions, resource leaks, logic errors, null access, race conditions in async code, swallowed exceptions. Trace execution flow before reporting. Output: create_suggestion titled 'Bug Audit - {date}' listing 3-5 confirmed bugs with file:line, execution trace, and fix.
